characterList.description: A light-skinned male with dark blonde hair, wearing a dark green uniform shirt with yellow and white details. He is a police officer for the Hampton Police Department, sitting in the driver's seat of a white van with green stripes and a large, white, round light on top.
characterList.name: Man

content_metadata.description: A video featuring a police officer in Hampton discussing the status of the park and its reopening plans amid COVID-19 restrictions.

qAndA.answer: It will be turned into a two-way street instead of a one-way street.
